leadText: (Japanese: シロガネ山修業編 《前篇》 The Training Chapter (Part 1)) is the first special chapter of the Pokémon Adventures manga taking place during and 's training on Mt. Silver. This chapter was first published in Pokémon the Comic on June 7, 2013, and was the result of Red and Pika respectively winning the human and Pokémon sections on the 2011 Netkun popularity poll.
